additional_info.subject: ID0442509-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP/R1 170001369] CP1 charging session issue CRM:02889000392
additional_info.body:
Here is the full details of the contactors error:
This error flag denotes the error in SiD internal outgoing contactor coils (OGC) or state of dispenser preparation test (special EoL test) for the DC outlet.
Error flag value = true when error occurs and this results in outlet going out of order. This can occur in one of the two cases mentioned below:
(a) Outgoing coils welded are detected when charging is OFF (this could happen in critical condition when power contacts are detected as welded with aux contact stuck {Fbk:1} or not stuck {Fbk:0} for long duration of time)
(b) If weld detection cannot be enabled due to internal error or when weld detection feature has been disabled and make-break timeout has occurred (this occurs when CMD:0, FBK:1 for time duration of 1 sec)
It should be noted and sometimes CMD:1 , FBK:0 can be present for short duration of time. This occurs as the final command to contactor coils is combination of one from PLC and another from State monitor. so, due to State monitor evaluating the state first based on outlet CP states Cx or Dx and providing OFF command to contactor coils before PLC can release it
Error flag description is dynamic and changes as per states detected by algorithm
CMD: 0, FBK: 0, WLE: 1, WDA: 1, WLD: 0, WIR: 0, WCD: 0
The elements for the same are described below
CMD: command issued by PLC to OGC, true = on, false = off
FBK: feedback from auxiliary contact of OGC connected to digital input card of PLC, true = on/closed, false = off/open
WLE: true = welded detection feature is enabled. false = disabled (make-break timeout would control this error flag value).
WDA: true = welded detection algorithm has all necessary interlocks for detection ok and therefore is active, false = interlocks not ok, it may be due to charging ON, outlet voltage present, etc.
WLD: true = welded has been detected (
this state would be latched until WDA=true, WIR=false and detection is no longer enabled or until charger reboot
), false = welding is no longer detected or not occurred yet
WIR: true = welded detection has internal error and cannot be done (could be due to voltage transducer error, IMD comm error, self test of IMD active, etc.), false=no internal error reported by welding detection algorithm
WCD: inactive reason code in case Welding detection is not active for this DC outlet. non-zero if WDA=false, zero if WDA=true (this tag is used for internal use)
Click here to view WCD codes...
1
Control Init Pending
Outlet voltage not less than 12V when detections are enabled
2
Chrg opr mode is not running
Charger maybe in error or some other operating state and not in ready
3
Coil has active ON cmd
ON command from automation PLC is active
4
Control pilot state not A/E/F
CP state maybe B,C,D , so have to wait until it has returned
5
EV connection request active
EV is requesting connection, so detection is disabled
6
IMD not initalized
IMD comm error or initialization with over modus RTU not done
7
IMD is in self test mode
IMD is doing own self test with insulation measurements
8
IMD has insulation alarm
IMD has insulation alarm, maybe weak insulation or device error
9
IMD has active error code
IMD has active error code, maybe device error
10
Volt Transducer Lifesign fault
Outlet voltage transducers device error
11
Output Voltage > 60V
Outlet voltages too high, external voltage on outlet
12
External permit absent
Weld detection disabled by force from DB100 for this outlet
13
Waiting for enablings delay
enabling is received, however it is not sustained for longer period
14
Output Voltage MAV too high
MAV of outlet voltage beyond 7.5V
15
CGp has atleast 1 converter on
Converter group directly connected to OGC has alteast 1x conv ON
click here for WIR=1 reasons...
Weld detection Error enabling
Charger is operating mode running
There is no command to outgoing coil from automation PLC
There is no EV connected to outlet
Outlet is in charging Phase (from SECC) is not between Authentication and unlock connector
Weld detection Error conditions
IMD is not initialized
IMD self test not active AND IMD initialized AND IMD.InsulationresistanceCombined.Alarm is present
IMD self test not active AND IMD initialized AND IMD.InsulationresistanceUnipolar.Alarm is present
IMD self test not active AND IMD initialized AND Received Error code from IMD which is not zero
Outlet Voltage transducer raw value is less than life sign threshold
Outlet Voltage > 60V
Outlet voltage Moving Average value is > 7.5V
When WIR = 1 using above?
Enabling = true
any condition = true
Welded detection feature is not available for DC3_QA19-20 and DC4_QA23-24 and in this case, WLE = false in this case and error flag shall be controlled by make-break timeout method.
Please let me know if I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
